moments.author: Thibaut Courtois
moments.quote: Courtois will miss El Clásico due to a flu-like illness.
moments.why: A massive blow for Real Madrid right before the biggest rivalry match.

moments.author: Milwaukee Brewers
moments.quote: He's a GAMER. He's a DAWG.
moments.why: Captures the hype around Sal Frelick’s clutch, game-tying homer in Game 2 of the World Series.

moments.author: Florida A&M University
moments.quote: TPD is investigating a shooting on Perry Street. Please avoid the area while officers investigate.
moments.why: Urgent safety alert amid tragic shooting near FAMU’s homecoming — major community concern.

moments.author: Byron Donalds
moments.quote: I am devastated by this senseless violence at FAMU on homecoming weekend. ... Praying for the 12 injured, including six children, and for the entire FAMU community.
moments.why: Emotional public response from a prominent political figure with ties to FAMU.
